title: I created 16 fantasy mages with AI assistance. Can you recognize the video game characters that inspired these four?
author: GamezGames
selftext:
Hi everyone!

I'm developing **Spellbook Scramble**, a free browser-based game featuring turn-based magical duels and a spell discovery system.

The game includes 16 playable mages, and 15 of them were inspired by memorable characters from classic fantasy video games.

I used AI-assisted tools to help create their visual appearances, adapting the designs for my own game.

Here are four of them. Their inspirations come from different fantasy gaming universes.

🔮 **Can you recognize all four?**

I'd love to see your guesses in the comments!

If you're curious about the game itself, you can play it for free here:

[https://gamezgames.itch.io/spellbook-scramble](https://gamezgames.itch.io/spellbook-scramble)

Built with Godot. No download or registration required.

comments.author: PerformanceComes1st
comments.body: is this your first game ever?

replies.author: GamezGames
replies.body:
Not at all! 😄

I actually started programming back in **1997 with C++**. My very first game was *Tour de Guet*, a turn-based strategy and management game.

Over the years, I experimented with several programming languages before discovering **Blitz3D in 2003**.

I went on to develop games such as *Cards of War*, *Cards of Destiny*, *Tour de Guet 3D*, and *Duel de Mages*, along with many smaller projects and experiments, including an unfinished 2D RTS.

I've always enjoyed experimenting with game mechanics and learning new things along the way.

So Spellbook Scramble is definitely not my first game, but it's another fun chapter in a journey that started almost 30 years ago! 😊

replies.author: PerformanceComes1st
replies.body: for being a small 2D game comparable to old flash games, its a lag fest.

replies.author: GamezGames
replies.body:
Thanks for trying the game and for the feedback!

I'm aware that performance still needs some work, particularly in the browser version.

Could you tell me which browser you used and roughly what kind of computer you're running it on?

That would really help me investigate the lag and improve the game.
